rules.public_chronology: A GEO public-release date after the exact checkpoint file revision is insufficient for clean_declared or target_label_unexposed status because the biological data and labels may have existed privately before release.
rules.inventory_requirement: Every source remains unknown until a checkpoint-bound accession, release-alias, donor, retained-cell, and target-label inventory excludes it or establishes the allowed exposure class.
rules.head_scope: These findings apply only to the exact frozen base checkpoint. They do not transfer to any separately trained annotation, GEARS, CellOT, or drug-response component.
rules.terms_scope: A clean exposure state does not override CC-BY-NC-ND restrictions or create open-champion eligibility.
